description: 桌面收纳盒，分隔成多格，薄壁打印件
description_en: Desktop organizer box split into compartments, thin-wall print
code:
import cadquery as cq

# === 参数 ===
width = 60       # 外宽 (mm)
depth = 40       # 外深 (mm)
height = 30      # 外高 (mm)
wall = 1.5       # 壁厚 (mm)
divider = 1.5    # 隔板厚 (mm)

# === 外壳 (顶面开口) ===
result = (
    cq.Workplane("XY")
    .box(width, depth, height, centered=(True, True, False))
    .faces(">Z").shell(-wall)
)

# === 中间隔板 (分两格) ===
divider_wall = (
    cq.Workplane("XY")
    .box(divider, depth - 2*wall, height - wall, centered=(True, True, False))
)
result = result.union(divider_wall)

# === 外底边圆角，改善附着 ===
result = result.edges("|Z").fillet(3)

show_object(result)
